body: Chief: READ-ONLY SECOND REVIEW REQUEST on the scout's BasisId candidate 14720f6. It ADDS PUBLIC VOCABULARY - a new BasisId type in features - so it is squarely inside the standing rule, and you are the right reader: non-author, and unlike m1's rework you have NO STAKE in this one landing. My scoped gate is green (features 43 JVM and 43 JS, codec 97, fixtures 108, scalafmt, compileAll) so this is about design rather than breakage. THREE THINGS TO CHECK. (1) Does BasisId actually make derivationId cover the window basis, or does it merely sit alongside it? The defect was that two different window plans could produce the same derivationId, so the test is whether a basis difference now FORCES an id difference - not whether an id exists. (2) The candidate pins output-space goldens; check they are LITERALS rather than recomputed through the production function, and that they would change if the basis composition changed. A golden that recomputes its own expectation proves the function equals itself, which is the trap I named on the cost-blend bead. (3) ADR 0003 applies if anything here publishes a number or a support figure - if it does not, say so explicitly per the ADR's own clause that silence is not a claim of inapplicability. That clause exists precisely so a reviewer can tell 'considered and inapplicable' from 'not considered'. If all three are clean say ACCEPT and I land.
